name: RoboBlocks
author: roboblocks@example.com
description: Dedicated server for RoboBlocks, a block-built robot combat game. Serves the game in the browser at http://<ip>:<port>/, relays multiplayer over WebSocket, and hosts always-on match servers with AI fill, automatic match start and map/mode rotation. No dependencies beyond Node.js 18+. Updates itself on every restart from UPDATE_FROM, DOWNLOAD_URL or GIT_REPO (set AUTO_UPDATE to 0 to turn that off).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# RoboBlocks dedicated server installer (runs once, in the install container)
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
echo "RoboBlocks installer starting"

fetch_dir=""
if [ -n "${GIT_REPO}" ]; then
  echo "Cloning RoboBlocks from ${GIT_REPO}"
  rm -rf /tmp/bc
  if [ -n "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then timeout 300 git clone --depth 1 --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${GIT_REPO}" /tmp/bc; else timeout 300 git clone --depth 1 "${GIT_REPO}" /tmp/bc; fi
  if [ -d /tmp/bc ]; then fetch_dir=/tmp/bc; else echo "git clone failed: check the address, and that this node can reach it."; fi
elif [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
  echo "Downloading RoboBlocks from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
  rm -rf /tmp/bc /tmp/bc.tar.gz && mkdir -p /tmp/bc
  # time limits and retries, so a blocked network fails with a message instead of hanging
  if curl -fL --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 300 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -sS "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" -o /tmp/bc.tar.gz; then
    echo "Downloaded $(du -h /tmp/bc.tar.gz | cut -f1). Unpacking."
    if tar -xzf /tmp/bc.tar.gz -C /tmp/bc; then fetch_dir=/tmp/bc; else echo "The download is not a valid .tar.gz."; fi
  else
    echo "Download failed. The install container could not fetch ${DOWNLOAD_URL}."
    echo "Check that this node has internet access and DNS for Docker containers (github.com and objects.githubusercontent.com),"
    echo "or upload roboblocks-server.tar.gz with the File Manager instead (see below)."
  fi
fi

if [ -n "${fetch_dir}" ]; then
  # the package may sit at the archive root or one folder down
  idx=$(find "${fetch_dir}" -maxdepth 3 -path '*server/index.js' | head -n 1)
  src=$(dirname "$(dirname "${idx}")")
  if [ -n "${idx}" ] && [ -f "${src}/server/index.js" ]; then
    cp -a "${src}/." /mnt/server/
    rm -rf /mnt/server/.git
  else
    echo "Could not find server/index.js in the download."
  fi
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/server/index.js ]; then
  echo "RoboBlocks is installed. Start the server, then open http://<server-ip>:<port>/ in a browser."
else
  echo "No RoboBlocks files yet. Upload roboblocks-server.tar.gz with the File Manager and unarchive it so that"
  echo "server/index.js sits in the server's top folder, or fix DOWNLOAD_URL / GIT_REPO and reinstall."
fi
exit 0

variables.name: Hosted servers
variables.description: Comma-separated server ids to host from servers.json, or "all". Defaults: sv-scrap, sv-beacon, sv-last, sv-war.

variables.name: AI level
variables.description: Pilot level (1-10) used for AI bots: sets their armor tier, CPU budget and weapon mark.

variables.name: AI bots
variables.description: 1 fills empty slots in every room with AI bots. 0 makes every room players only (rooms can also set "bots": false one by one in servers.json).

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: Most browser players allowed on this server at once.

variables.name: Run matches when empty
variables.description: 1 keeps AI-only matches running with nobody online. 0 idles each server in warmup until a player joins, which saves CPU.

variables.name: Download URL
variables.description: A .tar.gz of the server files, used by the installer and on every restart to update. The default is the newest official GitHub release. Clear it to stop updating from GitHub (or use UPDATE_FROM / GIT_REPO instead).

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: Optional. A Git repo with the server files (package.json, server/, public/, vendor/). Used by the installer and to update on restart; needs git in the container.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: Optional branch for the Git repository.

variables.name: Trust reverse proxy
variables.description: 1 reads player addresses from X-Forwarded-For. Turn on only behind your own reverse proxy, so IP bans hit the right address.

variables.name: Require accounts
variables.description: 1 means only signed-in pilots can play here, so every pilot's progress and garage is saved on this server.

variables.name: Everything unlocked
variables.description: 1 gives everyone on this server every part, armor tier, material, finish and CPU core, with no level or Tech Tree requirements. Players' own progress is not changed and comes back when it is off.

variables.name: Discord webhook
variables.description: Optional Discord channel webhook URL. Match results from the hosted servers are posted there.

variables.name: Discord invite
variables.description: Optional Discord invite link shown on the tester page at /join.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name shown for this server in the in-game server browser.

variables.name: Public address
variables.description: The address players open, e.g. https://play.example.com. Needed to be listed in the server browser.

variables.name: Act as hub
variables.description: 1 makes this server the server-browser hub that other RoboBlocks servers report to.

variables.name: Hub address
variables.description: Address of a hub server (one with BC_HUB=1). This server reports to it and shows its list in the server browser.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: 1 keeps the server up to date by itself: it installs new releases on every start and while running (then restarts when empty). 0 turns it off (the update console command still works). Your data and settings are never touched.

variables.name: Update from server
variables.description: Optional. The address of another RoboBlocks server (for example your hub) to copy updates from. It shares its files at /server-package.tar.gz.

variables.name: Update check (hours)
variables.description: How often (in hours) the running server checks for a new release. With Auto update on, it installs it and restarts when nobody is playing. 0 turns the check off.

variables.name: Restart after update
variables.description: 1 restarts the server by itself after installing an update while running: right away if nobody is online, otherwise when the last player leaves. Needs the panel to start it again (Wings crash detection, on by default). 0 waits for you to restart it.

variables.name: Longest wait for an empty server
variables.description: If players stay online, restart for the update after this many hours anyway, with a 5-minute warning in game. 0 waits until the server is empty.

variables.name: Desktop app updates from
variables.description: GitHub repository (owner/repo) whose latest release supplies desktop app updates and the /download page. Empty uses the repository in Download URL. Files you put in downloads/ take priority. "off" disables it.

variables.name: Share server package
variables.description: 1 lets other RoboBlocks servers update from this one (UPDATE_FROM). The package never includes your data, servers.json or balance.json.
